title: tap tap / nom nom
slide_intent: Show how two typographic voices can make a sequence audible in a short line. The transition connects an interface gesture to a sensory result.
strategic_value: Instacart can tell the story of ordering and eating through four short words, with the photograph supplying the eating moment.
demonstration: A billboard pairs tap tap in a simpler face with nom nom in a heavier high-contrast face. The green type panel sits beside a photograph of a person eating.
practical_value: Choose which part of a two-part headline describes the task and which deserves expressive emphasis. Use a photograph that completes the second phrase.

content_islands.name: Billboard context
content_islands.spec: Frame the wide placement within its surrounding wall and dark border.

content_islands.name: Type and photograph
content_islands.spec: Split the board into a green text field and a photograph. Stack the two phrases at upper left and align the signature near the lower-left corner.
